meta.title: RideSaudi | Private Chauffeur Services in Saudi Arabia
meta.description: Pre-book private chauffeur transportation across Saudi Arabia, from airport transfers to intercity journeys. Request a quote from RideSaudi.
meta.ogTitle: RideSaudi | Private Chauffeur Services in Saudi Arabia
meta.ogDescription: Pre-booked private chauffeur transportation for airport transfers, intercity journeys and premium travel across Saudi Arabia.

a11y.heroArt: Illustration of desert dunes at dusk. A placeholder until a licensed photograph is supplied.

hero.title: Your journey across Saudi Arabia, elevated.
hero.subtitle: Pre-booked private chauffeur travel for airport transfers, intercity journeys and every arrival in between. Tell us where you are going and we will prepare your quotation.
hero.note: Pre-booked only. An enquiry is not a confirmed reservation.

quick.title: Begin your enquiry
quick.hint: Nothing is sent yet. You will review everything on the next step.

services.title: Chauffeur travel, arranged around your plans
services.intro: Choose the kind of journey you need and request a quotation. Each service is pre-booked, so your arrangements are agreed before you travel.

airport.title: Airport Transfers
airport.text: Arrive or depart without the uncertainty. Share your flight details and request a transfer to or from the airport.

chauffeur.title: Private Chauffeur
chauffeur.text: A dedicated chauffeur for your own schedule, whether it is a single appointment or a day of them.

intercity.title: Intercity Transfers
intercity.text: Travel between cities in private comfort. Tell us your route and dates and we will confirm what is possible.

hourly.title: Hourly Chauffeur
hourly.text: Keep a chauffeur at your disposal for a set period, with the flexibility to move between stops.

corporate.title: Corporate Transportation
corporate.text: Arrangements for business travellers, delegations and teams, planned in advance and quoted clearly.

vip.title: VIP Transportation
vip.text: Discreet, carefully planned transport for guests and occasions that call for added attention.

why.title: Travel that is planned, not improvised
why.intro: RideSaudi is built around pre-booked private journeys. The value is in the preparation: knowing your arrangements before you set off.

prebook.title: Pre-booked by design
prebook.text: Every journey is arranged in advance, so your pickup, destination and timing are agreed beforehand.

plan.title: Journey planning
plan.text: Share the details that matter, from flight numbers to luggage, and we plan around them.

clear.title: Clear communication
clear.text: You receive a quotation and confirmation before you travel, not a surprise on arrival.

presentation.title: Professional presentation
presentation.text: A calm, considered experience from the first enquiry to the end of the journey.

airport.title: From the arrivals hall to your door
airport.text: Request a private transfer to or from the airport. Tell us the airport, the terminal if you know it, and your flight number, and we will prepare your quotation around your schedule.

points.one: Include your flight number so your arrival details are on record.
points.two: Arrivals and departures can both be requested.
points.three: Your transfer is confirmed only after you receive a quotation and confirmation.

intercity.title: The Kingdom is large. Cross it comfortably.
intercity.text: Private journeys between cities, arranged in advance. Name your starting point, destination and travel dates and RideSaudi will confirm what can be arranged.
intercity.emptyText: We do not publish a fixed route list. Send your journey details and we will come back to you with a quotation if the route can be arranged.

fleet.title: The right vehicle for the journey
fleet.text: When you request a quote you can tell us how many passengers are travelling, how much luggage you have and any vehicle preference. We will confirm what is available for your journey.
fleet.emptyText: Verified vehicle information will be shown here. Until then, share your needs in the quote request and we will respond with the options for your journey.

how.title: Three steps, no guesswork

one.title: Share your journey details
one.text: Tell us the service, locations, date, time and passengers. It takes a couple of minutes.

two.title: Receive your quotation and confirmation
two.text: RideSaudi reviews your enquiry and gets back to you with a quotation. Your booking is arranged once you have confirmation.

three.title: Travel as confirmed
three.text: Your journey follows the arrangement you have confirmed.

how.note: Submitting the form is an enquiry, not a confirmed reservation.

comms.title: Clear communication
comms.text: You are told what is being arranged, and you confirm it before it happens.

info.title: Transparent booking information
info.text: Your quotation and confirmation set out the arrangement for your journey.

experience.title: Considered customer experience
experience.text: An enquiry process designed to be simple on a phone, in English or Arabic.

planning.title: Careful journey planning
planning.text: Flight numbers, luggage and special requirements are captured up front.

support.title: Customer support
support.text: Questions about your enquiry are handled by the RideSaudi team.

quote.q: How do I request a quote?
quote.a: Complete the quote request on this page with your journey details. RideSaudi reviews it and responds with a quotation.

airport.q: Can I arrange an airport transfer in advance?
airport.a: Yes. Airport transfers are requested in advance through the quote request. Select Airport Transfer and add your journey details.

intercity.q: Can I request an intercity journey?
intercity.a: Yes. Choose Intercity Transfer, enter your pickup and drop-off locations and your travel date, and we will confirm whether the journey can be arranged.

flight.q: How do I provide flight details?
flight.a: When you select an airport transfer, a flight number field appears in the quote request. Add it there.

confirm.a: An enquiry is not a confirmed reservation. Your journey is confirmed only after you have received a quotation and confirmation from RideSaudi.

vehicle.q: Can I request a specific vehicle?
vehicle.a: You can state a vehicle preference in your quote request. Availability is confirmed as part of your quotation.

change.q: What happens if my travel details change?
change.a: Contact RideSaudi as early as you can with the updated details. The terms that apply to changes are set out with your quotation and confirmation.

cta.title: Plan your journey with RideSaudi
cta.text: Share your journey details and receive a quotation. No commitment until you confirm.

form.title: Tell us about your journey
form.intro: This is an enquiry. It is not a confirmed reservation. You will receive a quotation and confirmation before anything is arranged.

fields.vehicleHint: For example a type or size. Availability is confirmed in your quotation.
fields.flightHint: For example SV123. Helpful for airport transfers.
fields.name: Full name
fields.phoneHint: Include the country code, for example +966.
fields.consent: I agree that RideSaudi may use these details to respond to my enquiry.

errors.date: Choose a date that is today or later.
errors.consent: Please agree so we can respond to your enquiry.

status.failed: We could not send your enquiry. Please try again.

footer.tagline: Pre-booked private chauffeur transportation in Saudi Arabia.
footer.contactText: Send an enquiry through the quote request and the RideSaudi team will respond.
